title: TEHRAN, Oct. 18 – Iran's minister of defense Mehrdad Akhlaghi made  remarks during the session to review his qualification at Iran's Parliament.
text:
TEHRAN, Oct. 18 – Iran's minister of defense Mehrdad Akhlaghi made  remarks during the session to review his qualification at Iran's Parliament."

""
"-------"

"SOT1, Mehrdad Akhlaghi. Iran's Defense Minister (Farsi) (00:00 - 00:16): "I hope that soon, perhaps next year, the Islamic Republic's heavy fighter will take off. This year, I believe you are saying it is only taxiing; it will fly next year.""

"SOT2, Mehrdad Akhlaghi. Iran's Defense Minister (Farsi) (00:17 - 00:55): "We remain fully prepared, hand on the trigger, ready for war with the Zionists. Rest assured that your children in the armed forces will not close their eyes for a single moment until the fate of our fourth war is determined. The Strait of Hormuz, the model of warfare, all of this information is highly classified, and operational commanders are responsible for designing and preserving it until the day of battle.""

"SOT3, Mehrdad Akhlaghi. Iran's Defense Minister (Farsi) (00:56 - 01:07): "In the future, we will not build our factories where they used to be, but rather in locations that offer suitable mountains, suitable safe structures, and suitable human resources.
